gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8479 'Industrial robots, not elsewhere specified or included' (8479.50)
GRI 2(a): robot without controller is incomplete but has the essential character of the complete robot

rejected_alternatives.reason: robots for lifting/handling only; specific application not stated

missing_facts: whether robot is a handling/lifting robot of 8428.70
classification.rationale: Industrial robots are provided for in 8479.50; ruling 962659 treats industrial robots imported incomplete (without end-of-arm tooling) under 8479.50 via GRI 2(a). Missing controller does not change that.
